mapper.select: select bdi.biz_date as "bizDate", bdi.day_status as "dayStatus", bdi.frozen as "frozen", bdi.cutoff_at as "cutoffAt", bdi.sla_deadline_at as "slaDeadlineAt", bdi.open_at as "openAt", bdi.settled_at as "settledAt", bdi.late_count as "lateCount", bdi.catchup_count as "catchupCount", coalesce(stats.total_job_count, 0) as "totalJobCount", coalesce(stats.success_job_count, 0) as "successJobCount", coalesce(stats.failed_job_count, 0) as "failedJobCount", coalesce(stats.in_flight_job_count, 0) as "inFlightJobCount" from batch.batch_day_instance bdi left join ( select ji.tenant_id, ji.calendar_code, ji.biz_date, count(1) as total_job_count, coalesce(sum(case when ji.instance_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as success_job_count, coalesce(sum(case when ji.instance_status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as failed_job_count, coalesce(sum(case when ji.instance_status in ('CREATED', 'WAITING', 'READY', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as in_flight_job_count from batch.job_instance ji where ji.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ji.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and ji.biz_date = #{bizDate} and ji.dry_run = false group by ji.tenant_id, ji.calendar_code, ji.biz_date ) stats on stats.tenant_id = bdi.tenant_id and stats.calendar_code = bdi.calendar_code and stats.biz_date = bdi.biz_date where bdi.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and bdi.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and bdi.biz_date = #{bizDate}

select occurrence.workflow_definition_id as "workflowDefinitionId", occurrence.workflow_code as "workflowCode", coalesce(calendar.catch_up_policy, 'NONE') as "catchUpPolicy", occurrence.schedule_version as "scheduleVersion", occurrence.scheduled_fire_time as "scheduledFireTime", occurrence.biz_date as "bizDate", occurrence.occurrence_status as "occurrenceStatus", occurrence.request_id as "requestId", occurrence.last_rejection_reason as "lastRejectionReason" from batch.scheduled_occurrence occurrence left join batch.business_calendar calendar on calendar.tenant_id = occurrence.tenant_id and calendar.calendar_code = occurrence.calendar_code and calendar.enabled = true where occurrence.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and occurrence.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and occurrence.biz_date = #{bizDate} order by occurrence.scheduled_fire_time desc, occurrence.workflow_definition_id asc

select ji.job_code as "jobCode", count(1) as "totalJobCount", coalesce(sum(case when ji.instance_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "successJobCount", coalesce(sum(case when ji.instance_status in ('FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'TERMINATED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "failedJobCount", coalesce(sum(case when ji.instance_status in ('CREATED', 'WAITING', 'READY', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "inFlightJobCount", ( select count(1) from batch.trigger_request request where request.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request.biz_date = #{bizDate} and request.trigger_type = 'CATCH_UP' and request.request_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'LAUNCHED') and request.dry_run = false and request.launch_payload -> 'params' ->> 'batchDayCalendarCode' = #{calendarCode} and ( request.launch_payload -> 'params' ->> 'jobCode' = ji.job_code or request.dedup_key = request.tenant_id || ':batch-day-catchup:' || #{calendarCode} || ':' || request.biz_date::text || ':' || ji.job_code ) ) as "catchupCount" from batch.job_instance ji where ji.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ji.calendar_code = #{calendarCode} and ji.biz_date = #{bizDate} and ji.dry_run = false group by ji.job_code order by ji.job_code asc
